{{Quote|Piracy is a crime for which I have very little tolerance. It is theft and terrorism at its most base level. This kind of individual represents a grave threat to the Republic &mdash; we have achieved nothing if our people cannot travel the star lanes without fear of being attacked and robbed.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Laerron Woern''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], who lived during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
Laerron Woern was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] in [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]]. Woern operated as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], commanding a [[Woern's Pirates|pirate fleet]] consisting of several small assault ships and over a two hundred pirates of various races including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], and Elomin. He set up a base in the [[Drup's Star system/Legends|Drup's Star system's]] [[Drup Asteroid Field|asteroid field]] known as [["Woern's Asteroid"|Woern's Asteroid]]. Raids by Woern's pirates were indiscriminate, targeting [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and civilian alike. The targets were usually lightly defended cargo [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], unarmed [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]] and large civilian cargo [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. However, Woern began to turn his attention specifically towards the New Republic; his last eight strikes were against New Republic assets. Reports placed Woern on the planet [[Korbin]], in the [[Atrig system]], where it was believed that he was purchasing information on New Republic trade routes from [[Spy/Legends|spies]] within the government. The New Republic posted a reward of 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Woern's capture on the charges of piracy and theft; the [[Elomin Council]], considering Woern's actions a disgrace to the Elomin people, offered an additional bounty of 10,000 credits.<ref name="WBC" />

==Personality and traits==
Laerron Woern was an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood 1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. He was a shrewd bargainer and [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]], a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]], and an adept commander.<ref name="WBC" />

==Skills and abilities==
Woern was trained to use a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]]. He was knowledgeable about [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], cultures, languages, and [[Star system/Legends|planetary systems]]. Woern was also familiar with [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedure and dealing with the criminal underworld. Woern was a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], able to fly [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], [[Transport/Legends|transports]], and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. He was able to [[Astrogation/Legends|plot courses]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and operate the communications, [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], weapons, and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] aboard ships. Woern could also drive [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, and had training in demolitions and bypassing security systems.<ref name="WBC" />

==Equipment==
Laerron Woern was armed with a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and a [[Sword/Legends|sword]]. He owned a modified [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] that he used as his [[Woern's Assault Shuttle|flagship]].<ref name="WBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Woern was profiled in [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a sourcebook release in [[1993]] by [[West End Games]]. The image of Woern was provided by [[Mike Jackson]].
